description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of three language models—Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our)—on a financial question answering task, labeled “QA-1.” The models are listed on the vertical axis in a descending order, and the horizontal axis represents performance categories: “Correct,” “Partially Correct,” and “Incorrect.” The horizontal axis is labeled with a numerical scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Each model is represented by a grouped set of three bars, one for each performance category, with colors corresponding to the legend: purple for “Correct,” dark blue for “Partially Correct,” and light blue for “Incorrect.” For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the “Correct” bar measures approximately 0.88, the “Partially Correct” bar measures 0.08, and the “Incorrect” bar measures 0.04.  For EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, the respective bar lengths are 0.96, 0, and 0.04. RedWhale (our) has bar lengths of 0.96 for “Correct,” 0 for “Partially Correct,” and 0.04 for “Incorrect.” A black vertical line is drawn between the "Correct" and "Partially Correct" bars for the "RedWhale (our)" model. No bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
